title: Fix MDX syntax error: escape `<` in protocol-kernel.mdx
body:
## Problem

Vercel build failing on `content/docs/concepts/protocol-kernel.mdx:21:124` — MDX parser interpreting `<10MB` as invalid JSX element opening.

## Changes

Escaped `<` character using HTML entity:

```diff
-The core runtime is <10MB and does almost nothing
+The core runtime is <10MB and does almost nothing
```

Build now completes successfully (892 pages generated).
